summary: Selects and converts a named stream from an OAK Device CHOP into CHOP channels, with callbacks for complex DepthAI message types.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Toggle whether the OAK Select CHOP cooks

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: OAK Device CHOP running the DepthAI pipeline

key_params.name: stream
key_params.note: Name of the OAK stream to receive

key_params.name: queuesize
key_params.note: Number of OAK messages TouchDesigner reuses for memory efficiency

key_params.name: maxitems
key_params.note: Maximum items converted per cook for consistent channel counts

key_params.name: outputformat
key_params.note: Items as separate channels or items as separate samples

key_params.name: firstsample
key_params.note: Use only the most recently received message

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT for custom message parsing

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

key_concepts: OAK Select CHOP is used with an OAK Device CHOP and a stream name.
Simple supported streams can appear as named CHOP channels without manual coding.
Image detection messages can expose 2D coordinates and labels as channels.
Complex message types such as NNData or Buffer may require callback parsing.
Output Format controls whether items become separate channels or separate samples.
Use First Sample Only keeps only the latest message for high-rate streams such as IMU data.
common_gotchas: Requires a configured OAK Device CHOP and a stream name that exists in its DepthAI pipeline.
Some OAK message types need callback parsing instead of automatic channel conversion.
Queue Size affects memory reuse and message buffering behavior.
Max Items affects stable channel counts when detections vary frame to frame.
Items as Separate Channels enables time slicing, while Items as Separate Samples does not.
Use First Sample Only can intentionally discard older high-rate messages.
